posts.title: From an heir apparent to an heretic apostate, the tragic saga of Mughal Prince Dara Shukoh
posts.description: Dara Shukoh was born at Ajmer in 1615 to the Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan and Mumtaz Mahal. He was given an epithet ‘the prime rose of the empire’ by his grandfather Jahangir. posts.title: Bhargavas, the liberal/reformist Brahmins of Ancient India
posts.description: The Bhargavas also called Bhrigus claim descent from the primaeval rishi Bhrigu. Bhrigu is one among the primaeval progenitors (Prajapatis) created by Brahma. While other Prajapatis are said to have issued from different limbs of Brahma, Bhrigu is represented as having sprung from Brahma’s heart, the noblest of the internal organs of man or god. […]
